description: The Interactive Forest Atlas of Cameroon is a forest monitoring system that brings the country's main land-use allocations onto one standardised GIS platform to support forest management and land-use planning. The atlas page read on 2026-09-28 explains that the underlying database is managed and updated by the Ministry of Forests and Wildlife with the World Resources Institute, that it combines forest management classes (such as forest concessions and protected areas) with tree cover extent and change from Global Forest Watch and near real-time GLAD and RADD deforestation alerts, and that periodic publications are offered in a downloads section. Coverage is national. Access is free, and the atlas data are released under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: allocations reflect official records that may lag reality, alerts are satellite detections that need field checking, and infrastructure layers are limited to those relevant to forestry. It supports land-cover and land-use context for hazard exposure and environmental impact studies of roads, mines and energy lines in Cameroon's forests. No related Cameroon forest record is catalogued; Global Forest Watch data complement it.
